title: Orunmila odù log header, schema version 1: DRAFT
description: The odù log's first line, where its hash chain starts. It names the session and the raw log it was reconciled from.
$comment: agent's choice, LD167: the hash chain checks seq from 0 (spec/hash-chain.md), as the retention log's header does. Unknown fields are allowed (brief v4 line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as the odù log's header.

seq.description: The header is the first record of the odù log; odùs follow from seq 1.

raw_header.description: The hash of the raw log's session header, so the odù log is tied to the raw log it came from.
